title: ASCEND adaptive survey definition
description: One file per survey in survey/surveys/<id>.json. Fixed starter questions per wave; an LLM asks up to N follow-ups per question under the systemPrompt. Cross-field rules (non-overlapping waves, prompt mentions the move-on token, cap ≥ starters) are checked by `npm run validate`, not by this schema.

$schema.description: Editor hint only, e.g. "./survey.schema.json". Ignored by the service and excluded from the config version.

id.description: Survey id; the file must be named <id>.json and participants open /survey/s/<id>.

title.description: Shown in the page header and admin.

irbProtocol.description: e.g. "VT IRB #26-817". Shown to researchers only.

notes.description: Free-text operator notes (JSON has no comments). Never shown to participants.

status.description: draft = invisible to participants (researchers can still preview); open = sessions may start; closed = no new sessions, key may be destroyed.

researchers.description: PIDs who may view/export CODED data and run preview sessions.

keyholders.description: PIDs who may upload the roster, export the PID↔code key, and destroy it.

roster.description: none = anyone with a VT login; optional = roster match recorded but not enforced; required = must be on the keyholder-uploaded roster.

guestAccess.description: PILOT ONLY. Allow signed invite links (/auth/invite) so testers without a VT account can take this survey. Guests get a `guest:<random>` identity that can never match a PID and so can never hold a role. Leave false for anything collecting research data — it is the switch that bypasses VT single sign-on.

sheetMarkdown.description: The information sheet, Markdown. Rendered once at boot; also served printable at /s/<id>/info-sheet.

declineLabel.default: I do not wish to participate

ferpa.description: Optional separate permission (e.g. FERPA records release). Omit if not needed.

label.description: Text beside the optional records-release checkbox.

requireNameAndDate.description: Require a typed full name and date when the box is ticked (stored in the keyring only).

opening.description: Shown before the first question and as the first message of the conversation.

id.description: Stable id for the wave (e.g. "w1"). Appears in exports.

opensAt.description: When participants may start this wave (ISO-8601 with offset).

closesAt.description: When the wave closes; active sessions are marked expired after this.

id.description: Stable id for this question, unique within the wave. Appears in exports.

tag.description: Free label for analysis grouping (e.g. "ambiguity"). Never shown to participants.

text.description: The question exactly as the participant sees it.

maxProbes.description: Overrides probing.maxProbesPerStarter for this question only.

starters.description: The fixed questions, in the order asked. List them in full for every wave.

waves.description: One or more non-overlapping windows. A participant gets one session per wave.

protocol.description: Name of the probing protocol, for the record (e.g. "DICE").

maxProbesPerStarter.description: Follow-ups allowed per question before moving on.

maxTurnsPerSession.description: Cap on questions presented per session (starters + follow-ups). Starters are always presented; the cap trims follow-ups.

probeTypes.description: Allowed probe_type labels. A reply with any other label is treated as a parse error and the session moves on.

moveOnToken.description: Literal the model outputs to end the follow-ups on a question.

maxQuestionWords.description: Follow-ups longer than this are still asked but flagged "overlength".

systemPrompt.description: The fixed, researcher-authored system prompt. Must mention moveOnToken and require {"probe_type","trigger","question"} JSON.

name.description: ARC model id, e.g. "gpt-oss-120b-thinking-low". See `npm run bench:model`.

maxTokens.description: Completion budget. Reasoning models count their thinking against it; 1200 is a safe floor.

timeoutMs.description: Per-call timeout. On timeout the session moves on and records llm_error.

reasoningEffort.description: Sent as `reasoning_effort` (OpenAI-compatible). Lower = faster. ARC also exposes `-thinking-low/-high` model ids.
